name: thiings-grid
title: ThiingsGrid
description: An infinite, pannable grid with momentum: drag, scroll or use the arrow keys in any direction and cells render on demand from a render function.
author: Charlie Clark <https://github.com/charlieclark>
docs:
Installed `ThiingsGrid` at `components/thiings-grid.tsx`. It fills its nearest positioned ancestor (`position: absolute; inset: 0`), so give the parent a size and `position: relative`.

Pass `gridSize` (the cell size in pixels) and `renderItem`, which receives `{ gridIndex, position, isMoving }` for every visible cell. Indexes spiral outward from the center cell (0), so `items[gridIndex % items.length]` repeats a finite list across the infinite plane.

The viewport is focusable: arrow keys pan by one cell, Page Up and Page Down by one screen (Shift for sideways), Home returns to `initialPosition`. Give it a `label` that names what the grid holds.
